source.citation: W. Guo, Kinetics modeling and 3-dimensional simulation of surface roughness during plasma etching, MIT PhD thesis (2009)

formalism_source.citation: O. Kwon, Surface kinetics modeling of silicon oxide etching in fluorocarbon plasmas, MIT ScD thesis (2004)

visual_audit.method: Original-resolution visual inspection plus independent Pillow open/mode/dimension verification of Poppler page renders

pages.content: Guo Equations 16 and 17, translating-layer yield and species balances

transcription.coefficient_semantics: rate-expression coefficients; not bounded per-collision probabilities
source_inconsistencies: Atomic F is absent from the printed neutral species footnote although Table 4.1 reaction 2 explicitly uses F(g).
C3F3 is printed with a superscript plus in the nominal-neutral species list.
Table 4.2 prints both the -421.98 and +95.31 physical-sputtering terms with cos^2(theta); the literal polynomial is negative over most off-normal angles.

angular_polynomial_policy.executable_interpretation: Use +95.31*cos(theta), completing the descending powers 6 through 0; retain all printed coefficients and clip only the small negative grazing tail.

movement_flux_policy.independent_worked_balance: Kwon printed page 69, substrate-feed movement flux for net etching
movement_flux_policy.net_etch: movement adds underlying SiO2 atoms to the translating layer in Si:O=1:2
movement_flux_policy.net_deposition: movement removes atoms from the well-mixed layer into deposited film in the instantaneous layer composition
movement_flux_policy.numerical_realization: solve etch and deposition branches separately and accept only sign-consistent steady roots, continuing from the incoming face state

claim_boundary.allowed: source replay of Guo/Yin C4F8-Ar SiO2 yields and transfer tests within a separately declared boundary mapping
not_allowed: treating coefficients greater than one as sticking probabilities
claiming a C4F6 reactor boundary is identified by this C4F8 board
fitting Krueger feature depth with these source constants
calling the inferred Table 4.2 exponent a verbatim source value
